# Test vectors

Files and corpora written outside this repository, held here so both
ports answer to the same bytes.

## Transparency-log vectors

`tlog.json` is generated by
[`aontu-lang/mod`](https://github.com/aontu-lang/mod)'s `goref/`, which
links the **pinned** upstream `golang.org/x/mod/sumdb/tlog` and emits
what it computes. It is copied here verbatim so both this repository's
Go port and that repository's TypeScript port are held to the same
bytes.

**Do not edit it.** Regenerate in `aontu-lang/mod` (`npm run vectors`)
and copy the result across; `mod`'s CI fails if the committed file
disagrees with the pin. Here, `TestTlogVectorsAreUpstreams` fails if
the file does not name the upstream it was generated from, and the nine
tests beside it in [`go/tlog_test.go`](../../go/tlog_test.go) fail if
the port disagrees with the file. Nothing yet checks this copy against
`mod`'s, so a regeneration there strands this file silently. The first
`@aontu/mod` release is what makes that checkable: the tarball carries
`vectors/tlog.json`, so a test can compare the two byte for byte.

The pin, and the reason it is v0.32.0 rather than the latest, is in
[`UPSTREAM_GO_MOD.md`](https://github.com/aontu-lang/mod/blob/main/UPSTREAM_GO_MOD.md).

## The JSON Schema import's corpora

Each is vendored unchanged in a directory of its own, with its
upstream licence, a README naming the upstream and the pinned commit,
and a skip ledger both ports read
([the vendored corpora](../../docs/contributing/testing.md#the-vendored-corpora)):

- [`jsonschema/`](jsonschema/README.md): the official
  JSON-Schema-Test-Suite, draft 2020-12;
- [`ajv-extras/`](ajv-extras/README.md): Ajv's tests in the suite's
  shape;
- [`jsontestsuite/`](jsontestsuite/README.md): JSONTestSuite's RFC 8259
  parser cases.
